slides.text: I realized my new apartment was haunted when blood started dripping from the walls. I wasn't terrified; I was furious. I pay three thousand dollars a month for this shoebox in Manhattan. 'Listen up, demon!' I yelled at the bleeding ceiling. 'If you're going to manifest in my living room, you're paying half the utilities!' A horrifying, skeletal figure materialized, looking incredibly confused.

'I am Malgor, Eater of Souls,' it hissed, floating ominously above my Ikea coffee table. I crossed my arms. 'Cool. I'm Dave, Eater of Microwave Burritos. Rent is due on the first, Malgor. And if you don't learn how to use a coaster, I'm calling a priest.' Malgor’s glowing red eyes blinked. He slowly descended, grabbing a napkin and placing it under my mug.

It’s been six months. Malgor is actually a fantastic roommate. He uses his telekinesis to change the TV channels when I lose the remote, and his demonic wailing scares off door-to-door salesmen. Yesterday, I found him aggressively vacuuming the rug. 'The dark lord approaches,' he grumbled. I nodded. 'My mother-in-law is coming. I know. Did you get the good guest towels out?'
